args.reason: Check current stock levels including on-hand, reserved, quarantined, and usable inventory for SKU-1004.
Check recent actual sales vs forecast and promotional windows to verify demand spike.
Check for existing open purchase orders for SKU-1004.
Retrieve supplier quotes and lead times for SKU-1004.
Check available budget, storage capacity, and autonomy limits.
Evaluate baseline plan and candidate plans to see projections and stockout/excess risks.
Simulate placing PO for 600 units with SUP-A arriving on 2026-09-24.

assumptions: Sales will return to baseline forecast of 50 units/day after promotion PROMO-1 ends on 2026-09-23.
args.rationale: Investigated demand spike trigger for SKU-1004 at NODE-BOG-F4. On-hand usable stock is 1,000 units with 0 open orders. Demand evidence shows recent sales averaged 130 units/day (2.6x forecast of 50 units/day), but this uplift is driven by promotion PROMO-1 (Spike promo), which runs from 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-23. Per policy, promotional uplift should not be extrapolated past the promotion end date. Over the 28-day planning horizon, baseline demand is 1,400 units (50 units/day). Without replenishment, stock is exhausted on 2026-10-06, resulting in 400 total unmet units from 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-14 and 12 days below safety stock. Supplier SUP-A offers SKU-1004 at $14.00/unit with a 7-day lead time (expected receipt 2026-09-24), MOQ of 300 units, and pack size of 50 units. Ordering 600 units from SUP-A arriving on 2026-09-24 completely eliminates all 400 unmet units and leaves 200 units closing stock (matching safety stock of 200 units, representing 4.0 days of cover, within the 12-day policy max). Total cost is $8,400.00, which is fully within the available budget of $50,000.00, and peak volume of 45.0 m³ is well within the 200.0 m³ storage headroom. Because the total spend of $8,400.00 exceeds the buyer autonomy spend limit of $2,000.00, approval is required.
important_factors: Recent demand uplift (130 units/day) is driven by active promotion PROMO-1 which ends on 2026-09-23 and should not be extrapolated post-promo.
Baseline demand forecast of 50 units/day over 28 days totals 1,400 units against 1,000 usable units on hand, resulting in 400 unmet demand units starting 2026-10-07 without replenishment.
Supplier SUP-A lead time is 7 days, placing receipt on 2026-09-24, well before stockout on 2026-10-07.
Order of 600 units (pack size 50, MOQ 300) eliminates all 400 unmet units and maintains closing inventory of 200 units (safety stock limit / 4.0 days cover).
Total order cost of $8,400.00 is within $50,000.00 budget and post-receipt storage of 45.0 m³ is within 200.0 m³ capacity; total spend exceeds $2,000.00 autonomy limit requiring buyer approval.
